Has merge conflicts, and I think needs code fixed still.
This only works if a single bit of the bitfield is set, right?  Don't we need to loop over the bits (or just explicitly check each one)?

The bits have to be mutually exclusive.  This was a spec error in using bits vs value.  

The rest of the CPER depends on the error_type to be decoded correctly.
I think Aushim may have fixed this already with a calloc instead of alloc.  PTAL at his patch.

Aushim and I looked over this.  There is no harm in keeping memset (not new code) and it's in 3 other places.  We are unable to definitely trust that the structure was already cleared.

Its note worthy though that calloc is used in all description string.
Please see replies.
